shape.text: The legacy token is an unprefixed lowercase 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal UUID, 36 characters, granted before 2024-04-01 and valid until regenerated. Heroku states no grammar in prose; the shape is one changelog example.
The legacy shape has no marker of its own. Scanner rules for it only match beside a same-line heroku keyword.
The hexadecimal digits may be uppercase in some tokens.

unresolved.reason: Provider examples are lowercase, two scanner rules accept uppercase and another does not, and no source says whether Heroku ever issued uppercase.

issuance.text: A legacy token cannot be newly issued; new tokens carry the HRKU- prefix, in a 41-character and later a 65-character generation.

collisions.text: The token is structurally identical to Heroku app, release, request and user ids and to the OAuth client secret and refresh token, so a same-line keyword is the only gate. An app id on a HEROKU_APP_ID line is the known false positive.

unresolved.reason: Recorded in a research note without a cited source in this family's contract; the contract holds the UUID-shaped siblings as an unresolved claim.
